name: @nest-rn-lens/nest
description: NestJS interceptor that reports every request together with the React Native screen that made it. Part of NestRN Lens.
author: isa

scripts.clean: node -e "for (const d of ['dist', 'dist-test']) require('fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && node scripts/mark-formats.cjs
scripts.test: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test "dist-test/test/**/*.test.js"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
